relations.evidence: nāgajaharṣapālasya pitā bhrātā svakātmajāḥ ... viṣudharmam idaṃ punyam akṣilaṃ śāstrasaṃgrahaṃ | puruṣottamavarmena likhitaṃ

date.as_written: prathivyāpannagapakṣa+++++ nā(ya)te | phālgune sitapakṣe ca riktādyātithayaḥ subhe || nakṣatra raivatau〇 jñeyā vāsare somanandane

purpose: āyur ārogyam aiśvarya-lakṣmī-saubhāgya-sampadāḥ, merit transfer to family (pitā, bhrātā, svakātmajāḥ)
notes: The chronogram prathivī (1), pannaga (8), pakṣa (2) gives NS 281. The prefix 'nāgaja-' in 'nāgajaharṣapālasya' could indicate that Harṣapāla was the son of someone named Nāga ('nāga-ja'), or it may be part of an epithet/designation. Unnamed family members of Harṣapāla (father, brother, sons, grandsons) are mentioned as beneficiaries.
